title: oracle vector
description: One recorded execution of a function, replayable anywhere. JSONL: one object per line.

rva.description: Function RVA. Canonical form; never a VA.

build.description: Game build the vector was recorded on.

args.description: rcx, rdx, r8, r9, then stack, as absolute values. Buffers passed in an arg are described by a matching 'mem' entry.

argbuf.description: Size of a zeroed scratch buffer passed as arg1. Exactly one buffer per vector.

mem.description: Spans to preload before the call.

span.description: rva: inside the image (normalised), abs: a fixed host address (heap/stack scratch).

bytes.description: Base64 of the span. Image bytes are allowed here; that is the one exemption.

returns.description: Expected rax after the call. Use the retn convention of the build; xmm results use xmm0.

writes.description: Ranges the call must write, hashed. Contents are never stored, only the hash.

caller_rva.description: Where the vector was caught, if recorded from a live caller.

frame.description: Call depth at the record, for grouping.

stubs.description: Recorded with REVI_STUBS=1 (imports return 0 and are logged).
